ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface; high-intensity (white/tan) pixels are localized to distal tips and sparse micro-speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer across both lobes; localized high-contrast tan/white contiguous blobs at the furthest lateral extremities (tips) of both lobes; diffuse high-frequency white speckling distributed randomly across the medial and lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 140 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 8% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; trailing edges exhibit high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (2-12 pixel variations) isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a distinct concave curve originating from the tips and meeting at the median notch; leading edges show convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 6-8 distinct circular high-contrast white ring patterns (rosettes) localized primarily on the right lobe; dense textured clusters of high-intensity pixels on both tips representing barnacle colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear disruptions on the right lobe surface consistent with minor abrasive markings.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization present on both distal tips; multiple circular white scar patterns (rosettes) distributed across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent protrusion of barnacle clusters extending beyond the biological margin of the left distal tip, creating a unique textured profile.
